CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_TMP
(org_no varchar(100), org_name varchar(100), org_lvl_cd varchar(100), super_org_no varchar(100), super_org_name varchar(100), super_org_lvl_cd varchar(100), crbs_org_flag varchar(100));

INSERT INTO VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_TMP(org_no, org_name, org_lvl_cd, super_org_no, super_org_name, super_org_lvl_cd, crbs_org_flag)
SELECT T1.org_no, T1.org_name, T1.org_lvl_cd,
  CASE WHEN T1.org_no = '0099' THEN ' '
       WHEN T1.org_no IN ('0050','0086','0088','0089','0090','0091','0092','0093','0094','0095','0096','0097','0098') THEN '0099'
       WHEN SUBSTR(T1.org_no, 3, 2) = '99' THEN '0099'
       ELSE T1.level_scd_org_no END AS super_org_no,
  CASE WHEN T1.org_no = '0099' THEN ' '
       WHEN T1.org_no IN ('0050','0086','0088','0089','0090','0091','0092','0093','0094','0095','0096','0097','0098') THEN '河北银行股份有限公司总行'
       WHEN SUBSTR(T1.org_no, 3, 2) = '99' THEN '河北银行股份有限公司总行'
       ELSE T1.level_scd_org_name END AS super_org_name,
  T2.org_lvl_cd, T1.crbs_org_flag
FROM CDM.C_ORG_ORG_INF T1
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM CDM.C_ORG_ORG_INF WHERE data_dt = DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}') T2
  ON T1.super_org_no = T2.org_no
WHERE T1.data_dt = DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}'

keyBusinessRules.description: 将机构信息从横表展平为纵表：第1层本级自身、第2层本级+直接上级、第3层本级+上上级（通过一次自关联跨级）、第4层本级+上上上级（通过两次自关联跨级），满足不同粒度下钻分析需求

keyBusinessRules.condition: 第3层和第4层使用INNER JOIN而非LEFT JOIN
